questions.trans: 右转航向330，下降到3000英尺，可以盲降进近，跑道36右。

questions.content: Descend to 3000 feet, information P is current.

questions.trans: 加速下降到高度180。

questions.trans: 加速上升到高度190。

questions.trans: 上升到高度280，快速通过高度180。

questions.content: Unable to expedite climb due weight.
questions.trans: 由于重量原因不能加速上升。

questions.trans: 由于冲突飞机立即下降到高度200。

questions.trans: 准备好时上升到高度280，离开高度层200时报告。

questions.trans: 离开高度200，继续上升到高度280。

questions.trans: 保持好自己的间隔和目视气象条件，下降到高度80。

questions.content: Cancel SID, track direct to LLK, climb to and maintain FL110.
questions.trans: 取消标准仪表离场，按航迹直飞LLK，上升并保持高度110。

questions.content: Experiencing icing condition. Request further descent.
questions.trans: 遇到结冰条件。请求进一步下降。

questions.content: Icing condition encountered. Request further climb.
questions.trans: 遭遇结冰条件。请求进一步上升。

questions.content: Experiencing severe turbulence. Request further descent.
questions.trans: 遇到严重颠簸。请求进一步下降。

questions.content: Reduce speed to Mach decimal 76.
questions.trans: 减速到马赫数点76。 Note：有的考点也会读成point 76.

questions.trans: 保持马赫数点84或更大。

questions.content: Maintain Mach point 80 or less.
questions.trans: 保持马赫数点80或更小。 Note：有点考点也会读成decimal 80.

questions.trans: 保持当前速度。

questions.content: Maintain 250 knots or greater.
questions.trans: 保持或大于250节。

questions.content: Reduce to minimum clean speed.
questions.trans: 减小到最小净形（光洁）速度。

questions.content: Reduce to minimum approach speed.
questions.trans: 降低到最小进近速度。

questions.content: Maintain 160 knots until 4 miles final.
questions.trans: 保持160节直到五边4海里。 *Note: 此处“160”可能读成“one hundred and sixty”.

questions.content: Maintain 160 knots until outer marker.
questions.trans: 保持160节直到外指点标。 *Note: 此处“160”可能读成“one hundred and sixty”.

questions.content: Descend to FL120, on speed conversion, 250 knots.
questions.trans: 下降到高度120，低高度时速度转换至250节。

questions.content: Cancel speed restriction, continue descent to 7000 feet.
questions.trans: 取消速度限制，继续下降到7000英尺。

questions.content: LMN-02 Departure, passing 2500 feet climbing to 9000 feet.
questions.trans: LMN-02号离场，通过2500英尺，继续上升到9000英尺。

questions.content: Maintaining FL350, cleared to destination, flight planned route.
questions.trans: 保持高度350，可以飞往目的地机场，按照计划的飞行航路。

questions.content: Request radar vectors for visual approach Runway 22.
questions.trans: 请求雷达引导，目视进近，跑道22。

questions.content: Request join downwind Runway 31.
questions.trans: 请求加入三边，跑道31。

questions.content: Request taxi to holding point Runway 13.
questions.trans: 请求滑行至13号跑道等待点。

questions.content: Request taxi to south maintenance ramp.
questions.trans: 请求滑行到南边的维护机坪。

questions.content: Request frequency change.
questions.trans: 请求换频率。

questions.content: 15NM to HRB, FL290, tracking to JMU, squawking 6543.
questions.trans: 15海里到HRB，高度290，直飞JMU，应答机编码6543。 *Note: 此处“15”可能读成“fifteen”.

questions.content: Contact Control on 118.9.
questions.trans: 联系区调118.9。

questions.content: Position OBLIK at 0646, maintaining FL310, estimating ZF 0658,WUH next.
questions.trans: 当前位置OBLIK，时间0646，保持高度310，预计ZF点时间0658，下一位置WUH。

questions.content: Next report at WXA.
questions.trans: 下一报告点WXA。

questions.trans: 省略位置报。

questions.trans: 本频率省略位置报。

questions.trans: 恢复位置报。

questions.trans: 由于跑道障碍物，延误待定。

questions.content: Approach time not determined due weather.
questions.trans: 由于天气原因，进近时间待定。

questions.trans: 由于流量控制，离港时间待定。

questions.trans: 修改的离港时间为56分。

questions.content: Expect hold at HUR VOR for 10 minutes due traffic.
questions.trans: 由于冲突飞机，预计在HURVOR台等待10分钟。 Note: 数字10可能会读成“ten”

questions.content: Expected approach time 44.
questions.trans: 预计进近时间44分。

questions.trans: 预计无延误。

questions.content: Delay not determined, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
questions.trans: 延误未定，很多飞机在等待天气好转。

questions.content: Approach clearance canceled, turn left direct to DA, climb to 4000 feet, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
questions.trans: 取消进近许可，左转直飞DA，上升到4000英尺，按公布的航图等待，预计进一步许可时间50分。

questions.content: Ready for approach.
questions.trans: 准备好进近了。

questions.content: Request leave the holding pattern.
questions.trans: 请求离开等待程序。

questions.content: After passing SY VOR, leave the hold on heading 250, cleared for VOR approach Runway 06.
questions.trans: 过SYVOR台后，离开等待，航向250，可以VOR进近，跑道06号。

questions.content: Leave JFK VOR heading 210.
questions.trans: 离开JFKVOR台，航向210 Note：部分考点JFK会直接按照英文字母 dʒeɪ ef keɪ 的读法读出来。

questions.content: Cleared to LHR, hold at LHR as published. Maintain 8000 feet.Expect further clearance at 18.
questions.trans: 可以飞往LHR，并按公布的航图在LHR等待。保持高度8000英尺，预计进一步许可时间18。

questions.content: Hold south of AMS VOR at 9000 feet, inbound track 270 degrees,left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute. Expect further clearance at 46.
questions.trans: 在AMSVOR台以南等待，高度9000英尺，向台航迹270度，左等待，背台时间1分钟。预计进一步许可时间46分。

questions.content: Cleared to the 180 radial of PER VOR at 15 DME. Hold south, left hand pattern, outbound time 2 minutes, expect approach clearance at 37.
questions.trans: 可以在PER VOR台180径向线DME15海里处向南等待，左等待，背台时间2分钟，预计进近许可时间37

questions.content: Information P received, stand 03, ready to copy ATC clearance.
questions.trans: 收到通播P，停机位03号，准备好抄收ATC许可。

questions.content: Gate 26, request clearance to London with information F.
questions.trans: 停机位26号，请求去伦敦的放行许可，收到通播F。

questions.content: Cleared to destination, flight planned route, cruising level 330,departure Runway 04, initial altitude 7000 feet. HZ01 Departure,squawk 2563, departure frequency 124.35.
questions.trans: 可以飞往目的地机场，按照计划的飞行路线，巡航高度层330，离场跑道04号，起始高度7000英尺。HZ-01号标准仪表离场，应答机2563，离场频率124.35。

questions.content: Cleared to destination via ZAM, flight planned route, D03 Departure,cruising level 230, squawk 3763.
questions.trans: 可以经由ZAM飞往目的地，按照计划航路，D-03号标准仪表离场，巡航高度层230，应答机3763。

questions.content: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 Departure, initially climb to 4500 feet, cruising level 310, when airborne contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
questions.trans: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，跑道36右，LKO-01号标准仪表离场，起始上升高度4500英尺，巡航高度层310，离地后联系119.7，应答机2515。

questions.content: Cleared via ZF-01 Departure, initial altitude 5000 feet. Departure frequency 125.9. Cruising level 290, departure Runway 04. Squawk 6563.
questions.trans: 可以经由ZF-01号标准仪表离场，起始高度5000英尺。离场频率125.9。巡航高度层290，离场跑道04号。应答机6563。

questions.content: Cleared to destination via flight plan route. Departure Runway 36L. HZ-01 Departure. Initial altitude 5000 feet. Cruising level 330. Departure frequency 119.45, squawk 5667.
questions.trans: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，离场跑道36左，HZ-01号标准仪表离场。起始高度5000英尺，巡航高度层330，离场频率119.45，应答机5667。

questions.content: Recleared to destination via ZF01 Departure, Runway 36R, rest of clearance unchanged.
questions.trans: 重新允许经由ZF-01号标准离场程序飞往目的地，跑道36R，其余许可不变。

questions.content: Recleared to destination via B213, WHA, R343, rest of route unchanged.
questions.trans: 重新允许经由B213，WHA，R343航路飞往目的地，剩余航路不变。

questions.content: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, initial climb to 2700 feet, request level change en-route, departure frequency 120.3,squawk 0722.
questions.trans: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，初始上升高度2700英尺，航路上申请改变高度，离场频率120.3，应答机0722。

questions.content: Ice is accumulating rapidly on the wings and fuselage. Request emergency descent to 6000 feet.
questions.trans: 机翼和机身的积冰速度很快。申请紧急下降到6000英尺。

questions.content: We are encountering moderate icing. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们遇到了中度结冰。请求立即下降。

questions.content: We made a diversion due to reports of freezing rain at our original destination.
questions.trans: 我们备降是由于收到目的地机场冻雨报告。

questions.content: We are on emergency descent due severe icing.
questions.trans: 由于严重结冰，我们紧急下降了。

questions.content: We are encountering clear ice. Request immediate right turn to heading 130.
questions.trans: 我们遇到了明冰。申请立即右转航向130。

questions.content: Rime ice was reported by previous aircraft during approach.
questions.trans: 进近中前机报告有雾凇。

questions.content: We cannot continue holding in icing conditions. Request descent immediately and cancel speed restrictions.
questions.trans: 我们不能在结冰条件下继续等待。请求立即下降并取消速度限制。

questions.content: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning message. Request to delay takeoff or change to another runway.
questions.trans: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告信息。请求延迟起飞，或换一条跑道。

questions.content: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning. Request to delay our approach.
questions.trans: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告。请求延迟进近。

questions.content: We made the go around due to wind-shear warning.
questions.trans: 我们复飞的原因是有风切变警告。

questions.content: We have received information of a new volcanic eruption. Will it affect our route?
questions.trans: 我们收到火山喷发的一条新信息，会影响我们航路吗？

questions.content: We are unsure of our position due heavy fog. We are holding position.
questions.trans: 由于浓雾，我们不确定我们的位置。原地等待中。

questions.content: We had a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence. Request immediate descent to FL390.
questions.trans: 我们的空速由于颠簸快速衰减。申请立即下降到高度390。

questions.content: We had to descend immediately due to wind-shear at our cruise level. We didn’t have time to request descent as the frequency was busy.
questions.trans: 我们由于巡航高度层风切变的原因不得不立即下降，由于刚才频率繁忙，我们没有时间请示下降。

questions.content: The airplane began to buffet when climbing through FL380. We had to stop climb immediately to increase airspeed.
questions.trans: 刚才上升通过高度380时飞机开始抖振。我们必须立即停止爬升以增加空速。

questions.content: We are flying near our maximum altitude. We cannot maintain airspeed in this turbulence. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们正接近我们的最大高度飞行。我们不能在颠簸中保持空速。申请立即下降。

questions.content: I apologize for the level bust, but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind-shear.
questions.trans: 很抱歉偏离指定高度了，但我们需要损失高度来改出风切变。

questions.content: We encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine. Request immediate climb.
questions.trans: 我们遭遇了大雨，右发暂时熄火。申请立即上升。

questions.content: We won’t have to deviate if you allow us to climb to FL430.
questions.trans: 如允许我们上升到高度430，我们就不用偏离。

questions.content: The thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 根据天气更新情况，雷暴将持续约40分钟。申请备降。

questions.content: We have encountered severe clear air turbulence. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们已遇到严重晴空颠簸。申请立即下降。

questions.content: Request a general heading of 050 due to multiple cells ahead.
questions.trans: 由于前方多个单体雷雨区，申请大概050的航向。

questions.content: We have stopped on Runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog. I say again, we are still on the runway.
questions.trans: 我们已停在23号跑道上，但由于浓雾我们仍在跑道上。我再说一遍，我们仍在跑道上。

questions.content: There is heavy drifting fog. We think it is no longer safe to taxi. Request to hold at present position.
questions.trans: 有较大平流雾。我们认为滑行不安全。请求原地等待。

questions.content: Frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west. If the holding is more than 10 minutes, we will have to divert.
questions.trans: 锋面天气很快由西移动过来。如果等待超过10分钟我们将备降。

questions.content: We made the go-around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable.
questions.trans: 我们复飞的原因是因为短五边很强的对流气流使进近不稳定。

questions.content: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet. Our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots.
questions.trans: 我们下降通过3000英尺时有逆温层。我们的空速突然掉了25节。

questions.content: We performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog. We could no longer see the runway lights.
questions.trans: 由于平流雾，我们执行了低于最低高度的复飞。我们不能够再看见跑道灯了。

questions.content: The latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 最新天气报说锋面天气和冻雨正在机场上空停留。申请备降。

questions.content: We can’t find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 飑线覆盖我们进场航路，至少在100海里范围内我们都找不到任何空间穿越。申请备降。

questions.content: We can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we’re concerned about low level wind-shear. Request holding.
questions.trans: 我们能看见尘埃涡流接近机场，我们担心低空风切变。请求等待。

questions.content: The latest SIGMET says a super-cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination. Is our flight affected?
questions.trans: 最新重要气象报表明超级单体雷暴正在我们目的地机场形成。我们的航班受影响吗？

questions.content: Request to continue our flight. Our ETA is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then.
questions.trans: 请求继续飞行。我们的预达时刻是两小时后，可能机场会在那时将跑道上的雪除干净。

questions.content: We had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets. You didn’t answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change.
questions.trans: 我们必须快速改变航向是因为冰丸。你没有回答我们的申请，因此我们设置应答机编码7700并改变了航向。

questions.content: We were struck by hail. Our airframe is severely damaged. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 我们被冰雹击中了。我们的机身严重受损。申请紧急服务。

questions.content: We have just encountered a lightning strike. Some of our instruments have erroneous indications. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们刚遇到了雷击。一些仪表出现错误指示。申请备降到最近的合适机场。

questions.content: We have had a lightning strike. So far no system seems to be affected. We will continue to our destination.
questions.trans: 我们已遭遇雷击。目前为止没有系统受到影响。我们将继续前往目的地。

questions.content: Roger heavy rain. Request to terminate our approach.
questions.trans: 明白，大雨。申请终止进近。

questions.content: Request to cancel our approach. The runway is not long enough and there are water patches.
questions.trans: 申请取消进近。跑道不够长，还有部分积水。

questions.content: Request to cancel our approach. Braking action is poor and we’re concerned about hydroplaning during rollout.
questions.trans: 请求取消进近。刹车效应差，我们担心滑跑时出现滑水现象。

questions.content: Request holding instructions. We’ll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter.
questions.trans: 申请等待指令。阵雨变小的时候我们再重新进近。

questions.content: We have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们收到了冻雨报告，范围从地面到5000英尺。申请备降。

questions.content: We have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport. How long will this last?
questions.trans: 我们已观察到在机场邻近地区有吹沙，持续多长时间呢？

questions.content: A sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes. We won’t get airborne by then. Request cancel startup and tow back to the gate.
questions.trans: 预计沙暴在20分钟内到达机场。到那时我们还没有升空。申请取消开车并拖飞机回停机位。

questions.content: Heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes. Request to terminate approach and holding instructions.
questions.trans: 较大的吹雪预计持续30分钟。申请终止进近和等待指令。

questions.content: Runway is covered with patches of ice. Braking action is medium to poor.
questions.trans: 跑道被大片结冰覆盖。刹车效应中等偏差。

questions.content: Ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge. Uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters.
questions.trans: 成片结冰覆盖跑道边缘大部分地方。未污染跑道的宽度约30米。

questions.content: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.
questions.trans: 消散的雷暴在我们前方。我们接近零度等温线。申请再向右偏离10海里。

questions.content: We have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o’clock, about 2 miles. Request immediate right turn.
questions.trans: 我们在10点钟方位，约2海里的地方目视看见了龙卷风。请求立即右转。

questions.content: The weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying. Request change our airway clearance.
questions.trans: 天气预报说台风沿我们航路将会增强。请求改变我们航路许可。

questions.content: The hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 飓风已大量聚集，而且将影响南海岸的全部机场，申请备降。

questions.content: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
questions.trans: 飞越的一名飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。申请终止进近。

questions.content: Request immediate one eighty turn to the right due volcanic ash.
questions.trans: 由于火山灰，申请立即180度右转。

questions.content: We have entered volcanic ash. Our radios and engines are not working properly, now heading 235, and descending to FL 220, squawking 7700.
questions.trans: 我们已经进入火山灰。我们的无线电和发动机都不能正常工作，现在航向235，下降到高度层220，应答机编码7700。

questions.content: We are landing into the sun in heavy haze. Can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity?
questions.trans: 我们在严重霾中迎太阳着陆。能把进近灯调到最大强度吗？

questions.content: Lining up Runway 35. Runway lights are too bright. Request to dim the runway lights.
questions.trans: 进跑道35。跑道灯太亮。申请调暗跑道灯。

questions.content: There are red lights ahead of us. Confirm taxi instructions.
questions.trans: 我们前方有红色灯。证实滑行指令。

questions.content: There is an obstruction ahead. Confirm taxi instructions.
questions.trans: 前方有障碍物。证实滑行指令。

questions.content: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
questions.trans: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭。请核实。

questions.content: The follow-me vehicle is leading us to taxiway L3. Our wings will not clear the other airplanes on this narrow taxiway. We are stopping.
questions.trans: 引导车正引导我们到滑行道L3。在这条较窄的滑行道上我们的机翼无法避开其他飞机。我们停止滑行了。

questions.content: We are stopping. The ground marshaller is still guiding us in, but I think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further.
questions.trans: 我们停止了。地面信号员仍引导我们滑入，但我认为如果我们再滑入，我们的发动机将碰到廊桥。

questions.content: We are stopping taxi. The boarding bridge is not at its designated position.
questions.trans: 我们停止（滑行）了。廊桥不在指定位置。

questions.content: We are shutting down our engines. There are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft.
questions.trans: 我们关车了。风朝我们飞机方向吹过来了一些盒子。

questions.content: We had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind. Request to change our pushback position facing west.
questions.trans: 由于强顺风，我们开启发动机有困难。请求改变推出位置，面朝西。

questions.content: Another aircraft has collided with us. I’ll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines.
questions.trans: 另一架飞机与我们相撞。在我们双方都关车后，我将下指令尽快撤离。

questions.content: The tow bar has been bent. Our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel. Holding position.
questions.trans: 拖杆弯曲了。我们的机务人员将检查前轮。原地等待。

questions.content: The tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage. We are shutting down engines. Request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus.
questions.trans: 拖车偏转撞到飞机前机身。我们正在关车。申请客梯车和摆渡车。

questions.content: A catering truck collided with our aft fuselage. There are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers. Request fire services.
questions.trans: 餐车撞到了我们的机后身。客舱有烟雾，我们正在快速让旅客下飞机，申请消防服务。

questions.content: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck. We are disembarking all onboard personnel. Request fire services.
questions.trans: 襟翼无意中被放出，碰到了油车。我们正撤离机上人员。申请消防服务。

questions.content: Our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance. Request ground maintenance.
questions.trans: 由于不正确的配载和平衡，我们的飞机机头已经离地。申请地面维护。

questions.content: We have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold. Can you alert hazardous material specialists?
questions.trans: 我们已发现货舱里的危险品泄漏。你们能通知危险品专家吗？

questions.content: Our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation.
questions.trans: 撤离后我们的客舱机组将指导所有旅客待在跑道外。

questions.content: The outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn. Request personnel to inspect.
questions.trans: 我们做180度转弯时外主起落架可能擦到了跑道灯。请求人员进行检查。

questions.content: We have a suspicious bag on board. Request bomb squad.
questions.trans: 机上有可疑的包。请求拆弹小组。

questions.content: The passengers are evacuating. The bomb is still on board.
questions.trans: 旅客正在撤离。炸弹还在机上。

questions.content: A passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory. He is making threats. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 一名旅客在厕所已安装一枚炸弹。他正在威胁我们。申请紧急服务

questions.content: Request a remote apron for parking our aircraft due bomb on board.
questions.trans: 由于机上有炸弹，请求远机坪停机。

questions.content: We have had a tail strike. Request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing.
questions.trans: 我们已发生机尾擦地。请求3000英尺停止爬升并返场着陆。

questions.content: We have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust. We are evacuating. Request emergency assistance.
questions.trans: 由于不对称推力，我们在跑道上突然转向偏出了跑道，正在撤离。申请紧急救助。

questions.content: We cannot get good climb profile due engine problems. Request maintain runway heading.
questions.trans: 由于发动机问题，我们不能得到很好的爬升剖面，申请保持跑道航向。

questions.content: We made a very hard landing. We’ll need maintenance inspection before our next flight. Suggest you check the runway touchdown zone.
questions.trans: 我们重着陆了。下次飞行前我们需要机务检查。建议你们检查跑道接地区。

questions.content: The center of gravity is disturbed. We will relocate passengers prior to approach. Request holding.
questions.trans: 重心被干扰了。进近前我们将重新安排旅客。申请等待。

questions.content: Request a large airspace to maneuver due flight control problems.
questions.trans: 由于飞行操纵的问题，请求较大空域做机动。

questions.content: My apologies for the deviation due the wrong altitude setting. Request further instructions.
questions.trans: 抱歉由于错误的高度设定而偏离，申请进一步指令。

questions.content: My apologies for the level deviation. We were caught in a strong updraft.
questions.trans: 抱歉高度偏离了。我们遇到了强上升气流。

questions.content: We used too much speed brakes and penetrated our level. Did we cause any conflict?
questions.trans: 我们使用过大量的减速板而穿越了我们的高度。我们引起冲突了吗？

questions.content: We were not informed of a frequency change. I will now monitor your frequency.
questions.trans: 我们未得到频率改变的通知。我将现在监听你的频率。

questions.content: Unable visual approach due company policy. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 公司政策原因不能目视进近。申请雷达引导。

questions.content: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 公司政策原因不能盘旋进近。申请备降。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: Are we being vectored too close to the parallel aircraft?
questions.trans: 有架飞机在平行飞行，我们是不是被雷达引导得太近了？

questions.content: Is the preceding aircraft crossing our altitude?
questions.trans: 前机正在穿越我们的高度吗？

questions.content: I can read you, but I’m not sure you can hear me. I will squawk ident to comply with your instructions.
questions.trans: 我能听到你，但我不确定你能听到我。我将识别应答机以遵守指令。

questions.content: I see wildfire at my 10 o’clock, about 8 miles.
questions.trans: 我在我10点钟方位，约8海里的地方看到了野火。

questions.content: I have heard an aircraft in distress but no one’s responding. I can help relay his message.
questions.trans: 我听到有飞机遇险了但没有人回应。我能帮助转报信息。

questions.content: Message relay: The aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean. His present coordinate is One Eight Degrees, One Five Minutes, North, One Six Zero Degrees, Five Two Minutes East.
questions.trans: 转报：遇险飞机将海上迫降。目前的坐标是18度，15分钟，北，160度，52分钟，东。

questions.content: The aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles Northeast of his position.
questions.trans: 遇险飞机说他将尝试在其位置东北10海里的区域迫降。

questions.content: Request offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
questions.trans: 请求左偏离10海里避开已报告的强下沉气流。 *Note: 此处“10”可能读成“ten”.

questions.content: Request diversion. The latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5 hours.
questions.trans: 申请备降。目的地机场最新天气表明雪暴将持续5小时。

questions.content: Our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. Request an immediate right turn to avoid it.
questions.trans: 雷达显示前方强雷暴回波。申请立即右转避让。

questions.content: Request immediate one-eighty turn to the right due to possible hail ahead.
questions.trans: 由于前方可能有冰雹，申请立即右转180。

questions.content: Continue present heading.
questions.trans: 继续当前航向。

questions.content: Resume own navigation to BK.
questions.trans: 恢复自主领航至BK。

questions.content: Confirm identification lost.
questions.trans: 证实识别丢失。

questions.content: Identified, position 50 miles east of BK.
questions.trans: 已识别，位置BK以东50海里。

questions.content: 30 miles from touchdown, contact Approach 118.1.
questions.trans: 离接地点30海里，联系进近118.1。

questions.content: Three sixty turn left.
questions.trans: 左转360度

questions.content: Orbit left for delay.
questions.trans: 由于延误左转一圈。

questions.content: Looking out.
questions.trans: 正在寻找。

questions.content: Traffic in sight.
questions.trans: 看见了。

questions.content: Negative contact due IMC.
questions.trans: 由于仪表气象条件，看不见。

questions.content: Traffic passed and clear.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机已通过无影响。

questions.content: Squawk 7563.
Reset squawk 5101.
questions.trans: 重置应答机5101。

questions.content: Squawk ident.
questions.trans: 应答机识别。

questions.content: Squawk standby.
questions.trans: 应答机待命（待机）模式。

questions.content: Squawk Charlie and code 5120.
questions.trans: 应答机C模式，编码5120。

questions.content: Stopping squawk Charlie.
questions.trans: 关掉应答机C模式。

questions.content: Affirm squawk 7500.
questions.trans: 可以设置应答机7500。

questions.content: Altimeter 1003 8000ft.
questions.trans: 高度表1003，高度8000英尺。

questions.content: Negative squawk ident due transponder failure.
questions.trans: 由于应答机失效，无法识别应答机。

questions.content: Turn right heading 340.
questions.trans: 右转航向340。

questions.content: Turn right 20 degrees.
questions.trans: 右转20度。

questions.content: Leave BK heading 190.
questions.trans: 离开BK，航向190。

questions.content: Fly heading 285.
questions.trans: 航向飞285。

questions.content: Stop turn heading 070.
questions.trans: 停止转弯，航向070。

questions.content: Request heading 180 due weather.
questions.trans: 由于天气，请求航向180。

questions.content: Confirm danger area 113 active.
questions.trans: 证实危险区域113有活动。

questions.content: Your radar vector appears to be taking us to the prohibited area,confirm.
questions.trans: 雷达引导好像把我们带入了禁飞区，证实。

questions.content: 50 miles right of track approved, when able, proceed direct TB.
questions.trans: 可以右偏离航迹50海里，如可能，直飞TB。

questions.content: Indicated speed 270 knots.
questions.trans: 指示空速270节。

questions.content: Maintain 300 knots or less.
questions.trans: 保持速度300节或更小。

questions.content: Maintain 180 knots until 8 miles from touchdown.
questions.trans: 保持180节直到离接地点8海里。

questions.content: Maintain Mach decimal 82, transition speed 310 knots.
questions.trans: 保持马赫数点82，转换速度310节。

questions.content: Maintain speed 280 knots or greater for separation.
questions.trans: 由于间隔，保持速度280节或更大。

questions.content: Cross CK at 35 or later.
questions.trans: 穿越CK台35分或之后。

questions.content: Cross DG at 24 or earlier.
questions.trans: 24分或稍早时间穿越DG。

questions.content: Do not exceed 280 knots.
questions.trans: 速度不要超过280节。

questions.content: Reduce speed to 240 knots.
questions.trans: 减速到240节。

questions.content: Increase speed to 300 knots or greater.
questions.trans: 增速到300节或更大。

questions.content: Increase speed by 10 knots.
questions.trans: 速度增加10节。 Note：题干中的“10”有可能会读成“ten”

questions.content: Resume normal speed.
questions.trans: 恢复正常速度。

questions.content: No speed restrictions.
questions.trans: 没有速度限制。

questions.content: Request speed 200 knots due configuration.
questions.trans: 由于构型，请求速度200节。 Note：有的考点也会读成due to configuration。

questions.content: Request speed 250 knots due turbulence.
questions.trans: 由于颠簸，请求速度250节。

questions.content: Omit position reports until LN.
questions.trans: LN前省略位置报。

questions.content: Next report at IP.
questions.trans: 下一报告点IP。

questions.content: Report required only at boundary.
questions.trans: 只要求在交接点报告。

questions.content: We have traffic at our 12 o’clock, 5 miles, 500 feet below, climbing.
questions.trans: 我们看到了活动飞机，在12点钟方位，5海里，低于我们500英尺，正在上升。

questions.content: Traffic indication at our 1 o’clock, 4 miles, same altitude,converging.
questions.trans: 活动飞机显示在1点钟方位，4海里，同高度，正在汇聚。

questions.content: Request vectors.
questions.trans: 请求引导。

questions.content: Unable to receive transmission on that frequency.
questions.trans: 那个频率收不到发报。

questions.content: Request 15 miles final.
questions.trans: 请求五边15海里。

questions.content: Maintain 3000 feet until glide path interception.
questions.trans: 保持3000英尺，直到截获下滑道。

questions.content: NOTAM says glide slope for Runway15 is unserviceable,confirm.
questions.trans: 飞行员通告表明15号跑道下滑道故障，证实。

questions.content: Confirm ILS frequency for Runway 17L.
questions.trans: 证实17左跑道的盲降频率。

questions.content: In case of going around, turn left heading 210.
questions.trans: 如复飞，左转航向210。

questions.content: Advise transponder capability.
questions.trans: 请告知应答机可用模式。

questions.content: Transponder Charlie.
questions.trans: 应答机C模式。

questions.content: Transponder unserviceable.
questions.trans: 应答机故障。

questions.content: ADS-B transmitter 1090 (ten-ninety) data link.
questions.trans: ADS-B发射机1090数据链。

questions.content: Negative ADS-B.
questions.trans: 没有ADS-B。

questions.content: Re-enter ADS-B aircraft identification.
questions.trans: 重新输入ADS-B飞机识别码。

questions.content: Stop ADS-B transmission.
questions.trans: 停止ADS-B发射。

questions.content: Stop squawk transmit ADS-B only.
questions.trans: 停止应答机只发报ADS-B。

questions.content: Fly no further west of your current position.
questions.trans: 当前位置不要再往西飞了。

questions.content: Unable identify the waypoint, request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 不能识别此航路点，请求雷达引导。

questions.content: Right heading 120, my own terrain clearance.
questions.trans: 右转航向120，自行避让地形。

questions.content: Heading 120, correction, 140.
questions.trans: 航向120，更正一下，140。

questions.content: We are too low to the surrounding terrain. Confirm we are still being radar vectored.
questions.trans: 我们高度太低，周围有地形。证实我们仍然被雷达引导。

questions.content: Confirm we are still above your minimum vectoring altitude.
questions.trans: 证实我们仍然高于你们的最低引导高度。

questions.content: Gate15, information C, ready to copy ATC clearance.
questions.trans: 停机位15，通播C收到，准备好抄收ATC放行许可。

questions.content: Cleared to destination, BK02 RNAV Departure, initially 3000 feet,departure frequency 125.4, squawk 3311.
questions.trans: 可以到目的地机场，BK02号RNAV离场，起始高度3000英尺，离场频率125.4，应答机编码3311。

questions.content: Say again all after 3000 feet.
questions.trans: 3000英尺后的内容再说一遍。

questions.content: Say again all before departure frequency.
questions.trans: 离场频率前的内容再说一遍。

questions.content: Say again the initial altitude.
questions.trans: 再说一遍起始高度。 Note: 此处注意the的读音，在元音之前，the读作ði

questions.content: Unable to cross LX FL150 due weight, maintaining FL130.
questions.trans: 由于重量原因，不能在高度层150通过LX点，保持高度层130。

questions.content: Destination Beijing, request departure information.
questions.trans: 目的地北京，请求离场信息。

questions.content: Bay24, request start-up.
questions.trans: 停机位24号，请求开车。 Note：部分考点会将24读作 twenty four。

questions.content: Start up approved, QNH 29.91.
questions.trans: 同意开车，修正海压29.91。

questions.content: Start up approved, altimeter setting 29.91.
questions.trans: 同意开车，高度表设定值29.91（英寸汞柱）。

questions.content: Start up at 35, QNH 997.
questions.trans: 35分开车，修正海压997。

questions.content: Expect start up at 35, QNH 1030.
questions.trans: 预计35开车，修正海压1030。

questions.content: Expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1004.
questions.trans: 预计49分离港，开车时间自己掌握，修正海压1004。

questions.content: Radio check on 118.3.
I read you 5.
questions.trans: 我听你5个。

questions.content: You are unreadable.
questions.trans: 无法听清。

questions.content: Can you speak slower?
questions.trans: 你能说慢点吗？

questions.content: How do you read?
questions.trans: 你听我声音怎样？

questions.content: QNH 997, I say again, QNH 997.
questions.trans: 修正海压997，我再说一遍，修正海压997。

questions.content: Stand 27, request pushback.
questions.trans: 停机位27号，请求推出。 *Note：此处“27”也可能读成“twenty seven”.

questions.content: Pushback approved, Runway 31.
questions.trans: 同意推出，跑道31号。

questions.content: Stand by pushback.
questions.trans: 推出稍等。

questions.content: Pushback at own discretion.
questions.trans: 推出时间自己掌握。

questions.content: Pushback approved, long pushback.
questions.trans: 同意推出，多推点。

questions.content: Pushback to taxiway A approved.
questions.trans: 同意推出至滑行道A。

questions.content: Pushback approved, facing west.
questions.trans: 同意推出，朝西。

questions.content: Cancel pushback, we have maintenance problem.
questions.trans: 取消推出，我们出现问题需维修。

questions.content: Ground, Cockpit. Ready for pushback.
questions.trans: 地面，驾驶舱。准备好推出了。

questions.content: Brakes released.
questions.trans: 刹车松了。

questions.content: Starting Number One.
questions.trans: 启动一发。

questions.content: Brakes set, disconnect.
questions.trans: 刹车刹住，断开。

questions.content: Request taxi.
questions.trans: 请求滑行。

questions.content: Taxi via taxiway C to holding point Runway 24.
questions.trans: 经由滑行道C滑至24号跑道等待点。

questions.content: Taxi to holding point Runway 24, traffic in sight.
questions.trans: 滑到24号跑道等待点，看见飞机了。

questions.content: Request taxi back for maintenance purpose.
questions.trans: 请求滑回进行维护。

questions.content: Negative. We need 10 minutes to cool the brakes.
questions.trans: 不行。我们需要10分钟冷却刹车。 *Note: 此处“10”可能读成“ten”.

questions.content: Approaching holding point, request crossing Runway 24.
questions.trans: 接近等待点，请求穿越24号跑道。

questions.content: Hold short of Runway 24.
questions.trans: 24号跑道外等待。

questions.content: Holding, traffic in sight.
questions.trans: 等待，看见（飞机）了。

questions.content: Cross Runway 24, report runway vacated.
questions.trans: 穿越24号跑道，脱离跑道时报告。

questions.content: Unable to vacate via A2, request full length of runway.
questions.trans: 不能经由滑行道A2脱离，请求全长跑道。

questions.content: Crossing Runway 24, wilco.
questions.trans: 穿越24号跑道，照办。

questions.content: Runway vacated.
questions.trans: 已脱离跑道。

questions.content: Giving way to B747 passing from left to right.
questions.trans: 给从左向右通过的波音747让道。

questions.content: Follow the greens to holding point Runway 05R.
questions.trans: 沿绿灯滑到05右跑道等待点。

questions.content: Cross red stop-bar at A1, we understand stop-bar unserviceable.
questions.trans: 可以在A1穿越红色停止灯，明白了原来它不工作。

questions.content: After landing Airbus320, cross Runway 24, report vacated.
questions.trans: 空客320飞机落地后，穿越24号跑道，脱离时报告。

questions.content: Taxi to holding point C3, Runway 36.
questions.trans: 滑行至36号跑道C3等待点。

questions.content: Behind Boeing747 passing left to right, taxi to holding point A1 Runway 24.
questions.trans: 后面的波音747从左向右通过后，滑行至24号跑道等待点A1。 （注：由的考点抽到的是passing from left to right）

questions.content: Ready for departure.
questions.trans: 准备好起飞了。

questions.content: After departure, climb straight ahead until 3000 feet.
questions.trans: 起飞后，直线爬升至3000英尺。

questions.content: Cancel SID, maintain runway heading.
questions.trans: 取消标准仪表离场，保持跑道航向。

questions.content: Lining up Runway 01C.
questions.trans: 进入01C号跑道。

questions.content: Ready for immediate departure.
questions.trans: 准备立即起飞。

questions.content: Cleared for immediate takeoff.
questions.trans: 可以立即起飞。

questions.content: Runway 06, cleared for takeoff. Report airborne.
questions.trans: 跑道06，可以起飞，离地后报告。

questions.content: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 06, wilco.
questions.trans: 可以起飞，跑道06，照办。

questions.content: Airborne, passing 500 feet for 4000 feet.
questions.trans: 离地了，正在通过高度500英尺，继续上升4000英尺。

questions.content: The airbus on final in sight.
questions.trans: 看见了五边上的空客飞机。

questions.content: Behind Airbus on short final, line up behind.
questions.trans: 短五边的空客飞机落地后，可以进跑道。

questions.content: After departure, turn left heading 190, Runway 24R, cleared for takeoff.
questions.trans: 起飞后，左转航向190，跑道24右，可以起飞。

questions.content: Request right turn when airborne due weather.
questions.trans: 由于天气，离地后请求右转。

questions.content: Take off immediately or hold short of runway.
questions.trans: 立即起飞，否则跑道外等待。

questions.content: Take off immediately or vacate runway.
questions.trans: 立即起飞，否则脱离跑道。

questions.content: Hold position, cancel takeoff, I say again, cancel takeoff.
questions.trans: 原地等待，取消起飞指令，我再说一遍，取消起飞指令。

questions.content: Holding position.
questions.trans: 原地等待。

questions.content: Stopping! Engine fire.
questions.trans: 中断起飞！发动机起火了。

questions.content: Request return to ramp.
questions.trans: 请求滑回机坪。

questions.content: Tire burst, possible evacuation on runway.
questions.trans: 爆胎了，可能要在跑道上撤离。

questions.content: Negative intersection departure due performance.
questions.trans: 由于性能限制，不能使用减跑道起飞。

questions.content: Affirm. We can accept intersection departure from C2.
questions.trans: 可以。我们可以接受从C2进跑道起飞。

questions.content: Request intersection departure from C2.
questions.trans: 请求从C2减跑道起飞

questions.content: Request Takeoff Runway Available (TORA) from intersection C2.
questions.trans: 请问从C2起飞的可用跑道长度是多少？

questions.content: Request Accelerate-Stop Distance Available (ASDA) from intersection D1.
questions.trans: 请问从D1进跑道的可用加速停止距离是多少？

questions.content: Request Takeoff Distance Available (TODA) from intersection E3.
questions.trans: 请问从E3进跑道的可用起飞距离是多少？

questions.content: Line up and wait. Understand one aircraft to depart from A2.
questions.trans: 进跑道等待，明白有飞机从A2起飞。

questions.content: Airbus 330 heavy, 8000 feet, Information X.
questions.trans: 空客330，重型机，8000英尺，通播X收到。 Note: 330可能读成three thirty.

questions.content: Join right-hand downwind, Runway 34.
questions.trans: 加入34号跑道右三边。

questions.content: Number Two, follow airbus 330 on base.
questions.trans: 第二个，跟着四边的空客330。 Note: 330可能读成three thirty.

questions.content: Number Two, traffic in sight.
questions.trans: 第二个，看见飞机了。

questions.content: Straight-in visual approach, Runway 34.
questions.trans: 直接目视进近，跑道34号。

questions.content: Extend downwind, Number Two, airbus 320 in sight.
questions.trans: 延长三边，第二个，看见空客320了。 *Note: 此处“320”可能读成“tree twenty”.

questions.content: Orbit right. Number Two.
questions.trans: 右转一圈。第二个。

questions.content: Number Two, follow airbus 320 ahead.
questions.trans: 第二个，跟着前面的空客320。 *Note: 此处“320”可能读成“tree twenty”.

questions.content: Make a short approach.
questions.trans: 五边不要太长。

questions.content: Long final, airfield in sight.
questions.trans: 长五边，看见机场了。

questions.content: Continue approach Runway 25.
questions.trans: 继续进近，跑道25号。

questions.content: Runway 27, cleared to land.
questions.trans: 跑道27号，可以落地。 *Note：此处“27”也可能读成“twenty seven”.

questions.content: Short final, request wind check.
questions.trans: 短五边，请问风向风速。

questions.content: Request low pass due unsafe landing gear indication.
questions.trans: 由于不安全的起落架指示，请求低空通场。

questions.content: Low pass approved Runway 27, not below 500 feet.
questions.trans: 可以低空通场，跑道27，高度不低于500英尺。

questions.content: Landing clearance canceled. Continue approach.
questions.trans: 取消落地许可。继续进近。

questions.content: Behind the Boeing737, cleared to land.
questions.trans: 波音737落地后，可以落地。

questions.content: Request low approach.
questions.trans: 请求低高度进近。

questions.content: Runway not in sight, going around.
questions.trans: 看不见跑道，复飞了。

questions.content: No contact at minimum, going around.
questions.trans: 看不见地面，复飞了。

questions.content: Wind shear, going around.
questions.trans: 风切变，复飞了。

questions.content: Going around, localizer fluctuation.
questions.trans: 复飞了，航向道波动。

questions.content: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, climbing to 3000 feet.
questions.trans: 按照标准的复飞程序，上升到3000英尺。

questions.content: Take first right. When vacated, contact Ground 118.35.
questions.trans: 第一个道口右转。脱离跑道后，联系地面118.35。

questions.content: After vacated contact Ground 121.6.
questions.trans: 脱离跑道后，联系地面121.6。

questions.content: Taxi to Stand 27 via Taxiway A.
questions.trans: 经由滑行道A，滑行至27号停机位。

questions.content: Taxi to the end of Runway.
questions.trans: 滑到跑道末端。

questions.content: Confirm construction work adjacent to Gate 37.
questions.trans: 证实37号停机位附近正在施工。 Note: 37可能读成“thirty seven”。

questions.content: Confirm centerline taxiway lighting unserviceable.
questions.trans: 证实中线滑行道灯不工作。

questions.content: Confirm PAPI light unserviceable.
questions.trans: 证实PAPI灯不工作。

questions.content: The Runway light is too bright. Request dim it.
questions.trans: 跑道灯太亮。请调暗一些。

questions.content: Flock of birds 3 miles final.
questions.trans: 五边3海里处有鸟群。

questions.content: Runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
questions.trans: 大片水覆盖跑道，刹车效应中等。

questions.content: Confirm airport rescue and fire facilities category.
questions.trans: 证实机场救援和防火设备的种类。

questions.content: Is the weather improving or deteriorating?
questions.trans: 天气在好转还是恶化？

questions.content: Thicker patches of fog exist further along the runway. RVR significantly reduced.
questions.trans: 跑道后端雾会变浓。跑道视程明显变差。

questions.content: Confirm current RVR less than 400 meters.
questions.trans: 证实最新RVR小于400米。

questions.content: Confirm visibility more than 1000 meters.
questions.trans: 证实能见度大于1000米。

questions.content: Is mid-point RVR available?
questions.trans: 中间点的RVR可用吗？

questions.content: Confirm RVR Runway 27.
questions.trans: 证实27号跑道的RVR。

questions.content: RVR Runway 27 is 600 meters.
questions.trans: 27号跑道的RVR是600米。

questions.content: Confirm touchdown RVR greater than 350 meters.
questions.trans: 证实接地点RVR大于350米。

questions.content: Confirm stop-end RVR 150 meters.
questions.trans: 证实停止端RVR150米。 *Note: 此处“150”可能读成“one hundred and fifty”.

questions.content: Confirm midpoint RVR more than 550 meters.
questions.trans: 证实中间段RVR大于550米。 *Note: 此处“550”可能读成“five hundred and fifty”.

questions.content: Confirm threshold Runway 27 displaced.
questions.trans: 证实27号跑道入口内移。

questions.content: The runway surface is damp. Braking action good.
questions.trans: 跑道道面潮湿。刹车效应好。

questions.content: Confirm the reason for our flight suspension.
questions.trans: 证实我们航班暂停的原因。

questions.content: Confirm our flight has been suspended due bio-hazards at destination.
questions.trans: 证实我们航班暂停是由于目的地机场生化物品泄露。

questions.content: Confirm the reason for impounding our aircraft.
questions.trans: 证实扣押我们飞机的原因。

questions.content: Tow approved via A to remote apron.
questions.trans: 经滑行道A拖飞机至远机坪。

questions.content: Request de-icing.
questions.trans: 请求除冰。

questions.content: Request frost removal only at the gate.
questions.trans: 请求只在停机位除霜。

questions.content: De-icing completed. Request taxi.
questions.trans: 完成除冰。请求滑行。

questions.content: Request start engine at the gate.
questions.trans: 请求在停机位开车。

questions.content: Request time check.
questions.trans: 请求校时。

questions.content: Request backtrack.
questions.trans: 请求掉头。

questions.content: Unable BK-1A Departure due performance. Request BK-1B.
questions.trans: 由于性能原因，不能BK-1A号离场。请求BK-1B（离场）。

questions.content: Request departure instruction.
questions.trans: 请求离场指令。

questions.content: When airborne, track extended center-line, cleared for takeoff,Runway 18.
questions.trans: 离地后，保持跑道中心的延长线，跑道18，可以起飞。

questions.content: Contact Arrival 118.050.
Request remote apron for maintenance purpose.
questions.trans: 由于维护原因请求远机坪停机。

questions.content: Maintaining FL350, expect descent after BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 保持高度350，预计过BKMVOR台后下降。

questions.content: Climb to and maintain FL310. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or greater until BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 上升并保持高度310。BKMVOR台前保持马赫数点81或更大。

questions.content: Descend to and maintain FL 270. Do not exceed Mach number decimal 79.
questions.trans: 下降并保持高度270。不要超出马赫数点79。

questions.content: Continue climb to FL 290, cross BKM VOR not above FL 230.
questions.trans: 继续上升到高度290，飞越BKMVOR台不高于高度230。

questions.content: Negative, unable cross BKM VOR at or above FL230 due performance.
questions.trans: 不行，由于性能不能在飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度230。

questions.content: Maintaining FL310 until advised.
questions.trans: 保持高度310，等通知。

questions.content: Descend to FL170, cross BKM VOR at or above FL210.
questions.trans: 下降到高度170，飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度210。

questions.content: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or above FL190
questions.trans: 同意，飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度190。

questions.content: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR below FL170.
questions.trans: 不行，飞越BKMVOR台时不能低于高度170。

questions.content: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or before 55
questions.trans: 可以，在55分或之前飞越BKMVOR台。

questions.content: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR at 43 or later.
questions.trans: 不行，不能在43分或之后飞越BKMVOR台。

questions.content: Request lose time en route due landing delay at destination airport.
questions.trans: 由于目的地机场延误请求航路上消耗时间。

questions.content: Request lose time en route to finish the checklist.
questions.trans: 请求航路上消耗时间以完成检查单。

questions.content: Request parallel offset from current track due weather ahead.
questions.trans: 由于前方天气，请求平行偏离当前航迹。

questions.content: Request parallel offset from current airway for 30 minutes due icing condition.
questions.trans: 由于结冰条件，申请在当前航路上平行偏置飞行30分钟。

questions.content: Proceed offset 10 miles right of track until abeam BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 右偏航迹10海里直到正切BKMVOR台。

questions.content: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
questions.trans: 可以左偏离航迹25海里飞30分钟。 *Note: 题干中的25可能读成“twenty five”，30可能读成“thirty”。

questions.content: Offset canceled, turn right to rejoin the A1 before BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 偏置取消，在到达BKMVOR台前，右转重新加入A1。 Note: A1有可能读成"Alpha 1"

questions.content: Clear of weather, request to resume flight route.
questions.trans: 已绕飞天气，请求回到航路。

questions.content: Climb to and maintain FL290, re-cleared to track direct to BKM VOR, the rest unchanged.
questions.trans: 上升并保持高度290，重新直飞BKMVOR台，其余未变。

questions.content: Estimating crossing LV NDB 1123.
questions.trans: 预计1123飞越LVNDB台。

questions.content: Passing POU at 43, maintaining FL310, estimating MLT at 55,next NLD.
questions.trans: 当前位置POU，时间43分，高度310，预计MLT55分，下一位置NLD。

questions.content: BKM 47, FL170 descending to FL120, abeam NLD VOR at 55.
questions.trans: BKM47分，高度170，下降到高度层120，55分正切NLDVOR台。

questions.content: Report 25 miles from BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 距离BKMVOR台25海里报告。

questions.content: Report 34 miles from Top of Descent.
questions.trans: 距离下降顶点34海里报告。

questions.content: Report crossing 270 radial BKM VOR.
questions.trans: 过BKMVOR台270度径向线报告。

questions.content: Report 28 miles DME 210 radial BKM VOR.
questions.trans: BKMVOR台210度径向线28海里时报告。

questions.content: Climb to FL220, report passing FL170.
questions.trans: 上升高度220，通过高度170报告。

questions.content: Descending immediately to FL190.
questions.trans: 立刻下降到高度190。

questions.content: Leaving FL220 for FL190.
questions.trans: 离开高度220，下降到高度190。

questions.content: Request clearance to enter controlled airspace northeast of BKM VOR at FL240 at time 43.
questions.trans: 请求在BKMVOR台东北方向高度240，时间43分时进入管制空域的许可。

questions.content: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect joining clearance at time 55.
questions.trans: 保持在管制空域外，预计在55进入。

questions.content: Request to leave controlled airspace by descent.
questions.trans: 请求通过下降离开管制空域。

questions.content: Request to leave controlled airspace by climb.
questions.trans: 请求通过爬升离开管制空域。

questions.content: Descending to 5000 feet QNH 1014, report passing 7000 feet.
questions.trans: 下降到5000英尺，修正海压1014，通过7000英尺报告。

questions.content: Request VMC descent to FL60.
questions.trans: 请求目视气象条件下降到高度层60。

questions.content: Descending to FL60, maintain VMC FL90 to FL70, report traffic in sight at FL80.
questions.trans: 下降到高度层60，高度90到高度70之间保持目视气象条件，高度80看见活动飞机报告。

questions.content: Request to join airway A1 at DAPRO.
questions.trans: 请求在DAPRO加入A1航路。 Note: 此处有的考点为request to.

questions.content: Cleared to destination airport via DAPRO, flight planned route,FL240, join A1 at FL240.
questions.trans: 可以按DAPRO计划航路飞往目的地机场，高度240，并在高度层240加入A1航路。

questions.content: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect further clearance at 55.
questions.trans: 保持在管制空域外，预计55分有进一步许可。

questions.content: If FL240 not available, we accept FL220.
questions.trans: 如果高度240不可用，我们接受高度220。

questions.content: Cleared to leave A1 via BKM VOR, maintain FL230 while in controlled airspace.
questions.trans: 可以经由BKMVOR台离开A1，在管制空域保持高度230。 Note: A1也可能会读成Alpha 1.

questions.content: Confirm we are under radar control.
questions.trans: 证实我们在雷达管制区。

questions.content: Confirm radar service is terminated.
questions.trans: 证实雷达服务终止。

questions.content: Radar service is terminated due technical failure. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or less for separation.
questions.trans: 由于技术故障雷达服务终止。因间隔，保持马赫数点81或更小。

questions.content: Confirm radar control is resumed.
questions.trans: 证实雷达管制恢复。

questions.content: Radar control is resumed, track direct to BKM VOR and increase speed to Mach number decimal 84.
questions.trans: 雷达管制恢复，直飞BKMVOR台，增速到马赫数点84。

questions.content: Affirm RVSM.
questions.trans: 可以RVSM。

questions.content: Negative RVSM due equipment downgraded.
questions.trans: 由于设备降级，RVSM不行。

questions.content: Request clearance into RVSM airspace.
questions.trans: 请求进入RVSM空域的许可。

questions.content: Unable RVSM due turbulence.
questions.trans: 由于颠簸，不能RVSM。

questions.content: Ready to resume RVSM.
questions.trans: 准备恢复RVSM。

questions.content: Position 42N（North）165E (East) at 0800, FL390, estimating 44N 180E at 0900 45N 170W next.
questions.trans: 当前位置北纬42度，东经165度，时间0800，高度390，预计北纬44,度，东经180度，时间0900，下一位置北纬45度，西经170度。

questions.content: At 150W(west) contact San Francisco Radio, primary 3494,secondary 11342. 注：部分考点为At 150W(west) degrees contact San Francisco Radio...
questions.trans: 在西经150度联系旧金山无线电，主高频3494，备份高频11342。

questions.content: At 144E(east) squawk 2000.
questions.trans: 东经144度时，应答机换2000。

questions.content: CPDLC connected.
questions.trans: CPDLC已连接。

questions.content: Continue CPDLC make position report via CPDLC.
questions.trans: 继续CPDLC，由CPDLC做位置报。

questions.content: SELCAL CODE EFFG, request SELCAL check.
questions.trans: 选择呼叫代码EFFG，请求选呼检查。

questions.content: CPDLC unserviceable, request to revert to voice communication.
questions.trans: CPDLC不工作。请求恢复到话音通信。

questions.content: We have three serious and five minor injuries on board. Request ambulances on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们机上有三人重伤，五人轻伤。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: One passenger is having difficulty breathing. Request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude.
questions.trans: 一名旅客呼吸困难。请求立即下降到较低高度以减小客舱高度。

questions.content: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
questions.trans: 一名旅客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器。请求机场保安到场拘留他。

questions.content: A stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit. Request airport security on arrival.
questions.trans: 一名闹情绪的旅客试图打开应急出口。申请机场保安到场。

questions.content: We have a hostage situation. Request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers.
questions.trans: 我们有一名人质。申请客梯车待命以便让旅客们下飞机。

questions.content: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们有一名旅客有严重的过度换气症。他得到了急救但情况没有好转。申请救护车到场。

questions.content: We have a passenger with a suspected heart attack. Request diversion to a suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们有名乘客疑似有心脏病。申请备降到合适机场。

questions.content: A pregnant passenger is in severe pain. Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 一名孕妇承受剧痛。申请优先着陆和救护车到场。

questions.content: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously. Request police and ambulances on arrival.
questions.trans: 几名旅客在机上打斗。其中一人现在流血严重。请求警察和救护车到场。

questions.content: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
questions.trans: 乘务长告知我受伤旅客血型是O型血。或许该信息对急救医务人员有用。

questions.content: We have an 8-month old infant with head injuries. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们有个8个月大的婴儿头部受伤。申请救护车到场。

questions.content: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
questions.trans: 一名旅客癫痫发作后失去知觉。客舱机组提供急救。如需备降我们将告知你们。

questions.content: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
questions.trans: 由于严重颠簸，多名旅客和机组都受伤了。如能够，我们将告知受伤人数和严重性。

questions.content: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 一位年长的旅客去世了。我们将继续到目的地。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们发现一名旅客在洗手间服药（或毒品）过量失去意识了。请求警察和救护车到场。

questions.content: The sick passenger’s condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
questions.trans: 生病旅客的情况已经好转了。我们不再要求备降，请求继续飞往我们的目的地。

questions.content: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
questions.trans: 我们收到客舱的急救呼叫，但现在没人回应。我们能听见喊叫声和斗殴声。我们的客舱机组可能受到了胁迫。

questions.content: We have a hijack situation on board. Can our destination airport provide armed intervention?
questions.trans: 我们被劫机了。我们的目的地机场能提供武装干涉吗？

questions.content: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera. They are kicking the cockpit door.
questions.trans: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具手拿利器的人。他们正在踢驾驶舱门。

questions.content: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
questions.trans: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域。有两名劫机者正站在过道。

questions.content: One of the terrorists is about forty years old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
questions.trans: 一名恐怖分子大约40岁。他有180厘米高，穿着棕色衬衫和深色裤子。

questions.content: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
questions.trans: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱。他约30岁。戴一顶帽子并双肩背包。

questions.content: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don’t fly to another destination.
questions.trans: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯。正威胁我们如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们要杀死旅客。

questions.content: Some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons.
questions.trans: 一些劫机犯拿着锋利的、尖锐的武器。

questions.content: There is a stand-off in the cabin. Some of the hijackers are carrying blades.
questions.trans: 客舱已陷于僵持状态。一些劫机犯拿着刀片。

questions.content: Terrorists started to injure passengers.
questions.trans: 恐怖分子开始伤害旅客了。

questions.content: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
questions.trans: 我们将停留在跑道上。劫机犯已把四名人质带到了客舱后部。

questions.content: Terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew.
questions.trans: 恐怖分子们威胁他们将要杀死旅客和机组了。

questions.content: The air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects. The situation is now under control.
questions.trans: 安全保安和旅客们已经制服了五名疑犯。局面得到了控制。

questions.content: A suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection.
questions.trans: 客舱检查中发现了可疑手提箱。

questions.content: The air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles.
questions.trans: 空中保安正在搜查飞机里面的任何可疑物品。

questions.content: Some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin.
questions.trans: 客舱后部的一块面板后面发现一些爆炸物。

questions.content: What do the bomb-disposal experts suggest we do?
questions.trans: 拆弹专家们建议我们做什么？

questions.content: The cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely.
questions.trans: 客舱机组报告一名旅客行为怪异。

questions.content: A bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke. Request emergency descent.
questions.trans: 炸弹已爆炸，客舱到处是烟雾。申请紧急下降。

questions.content: We are evacuating on the runway. Be advised the bomb is still on board.
questions.trans: 我们正在跑道上紧急撤离。请你告知相关人员炸弹还在飞机上。

questions.content: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
questions.trans: 由于导航失效，我们不确定位置。如有任何电台能听到我们，请回话。

questions.content: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
questions.trans: 我们因仪表失效只有备用磁罗盘。现在航向245。请求导航援助。

questions.content: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们由于飞行管理计算机失效不能确定位置。最后已知位置FUPAD以北5海里，现在航向165以避开天气。

questions.content: We have navigation map drift. Request climb to MEA.
questions.trans: 我们有导航地图漂移。申请上升到最低航路高度。

questions.content: Our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board.
questions.trans: 我们货物舱单表明机上有80千克的锂电池。

questions.content: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
questions.trans: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池。我们正在核实。请求延迟推出。

questions.content: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
questions.trans: 我们的货舱有烟雾警告。我们已释放灭火瓶。我们担心货舱的锂电池。

questions.content: The cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 客舱机组已用完了手提式灭火器，申请备降。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
questions.trans: 我们停在跑道上后请求立即连接客梯车。我们想尽快让旅客离机。

questions.content: We almost had a mid-air collision with another aircraft.
questions.trans: 我们差点与另一架飞机空中相撞。

questions.content: The conflicting traffic is military. Request avoiding action.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机是军用机。申请避让措施。

questions.content: Does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours?
questions.trans: 不明飞机的飞行路线和我们会聚吗？

questions.content: The conflicting traffic is gray, possibly a military aircraft.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机是灰色的，可能是军用机。

questions.content: We have traffic indication at 2 o’clock, 300 feet above our level.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机显示在2点钟方位，高于我们300英尺。

questions.content: We have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o’clock, converging with our flight path.
questions.trans: 我们可能在10点钟方位有冲突飞机，与我们的飞行线路会聚。

questions.content: We have a possible traffic conflict ahead. Request radar vectors for avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们前方可能有冲突飞机，请求雷达引导避让。

questions.content: Request right turn for traffic avoidance.
questions.trans: 请求右转避让冲突飞机。

questions.content: Unable to comply, TCAS RA.
questions.trans: 不能照办，遵守TCASRA指令。

questions.content: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
questions.trans: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞了。我们几乎没有垂直间隔了。你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？

questions.content: Clear of conflict, request further instructions.
questions.trans: 远离冲突，申请进一步指令。

questions.content: We have injuries resulting from our TCAS maneuver. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: TCAS机动导致部分旅客受伤。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: Some of the cabin crew are injured. They were serving meals during the TCAS maneuver.
questions.trans: 部分客舱机组受伤了。TCAS机动时他们正在供餐。

questions.content: Some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren’t fastened.
questions.trans: 一些旅客受伤是因为他们没有系安全带。

questions.content: Some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks.
questions.trans: 一些旅客被热饮料烫伤了。

questions.content: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
questions.trans: 我们机上有三十人受伤。其中四人受伤严重。你能把此信息告知待命的医疗人员吗？

questions.content: We overran the runway end. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 我们冲出了跑道头。我们正在撤离。请求紧急服务。

questions.content: We veered off the runway. We are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit J5.
questions.trans: 我们偏出了跑道，正在撤离。我们的位置在跑道和快速脱离道口J5附近。

questions.content: We will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
questions.trans: 如果我们进一步延误，我们将达到最低燃油量。

questions.content: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
questions.trans: 我们宣布最低燃油量。我们到达目的地之后会有少于30分钟续航时间。

questions.content: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
questions.trans: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。我们的续航时间1小时58分钟。我们离最近备降场时间是1小时30分钟。

questions.content: We are declaring fuel emergency. Request priority landing Runway 03R.
questions.trans: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。申请优先着陆，跑道03右。

questions.content: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
questions.trans: 我们被一架军用飞机拦截了。它摇动机翼让我们跟着它。

questions.content: I’m trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率没有回应。

questions.content: The military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below.
questions.trans: 军用飞机正在指示我们在下面的机场着陆。

questions.content: The military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading.
questions.trans: 军用飞机已突然机动，表明我们可以继续保持此航向。

questions.content: We are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft.
questions.trans: 我们正在被两架军用机押送到国境线。

questions.content: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
questions.trans: 我们现在航向085。该航向我们可以快速离开禁飞空域。

questions.content: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
questions.trans: 如我们继续转圈，我们将在落地时超出值勤期限制。

questions.content: A crew member is incapacitated. Request diversion and medical assistance.
questions.trans: 一名机组成员失能。请求备降和医疗救助。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he’ll be fine. Request to cancel the diversion.
questions.trans: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的旅客恢复了意识。似乎情况不错。申请取消备降。

questions.content: Confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind.
questions.trans: 证实你会引导我们飞越机场上空然后做右三边。

questions.content: Confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft.
questions.trans: 证实我们与前机有足够间隔。

questions.content: Unable to expedite climb due performance.
questions.trans: 由于性能，不能加速爬升。

questions.content: Negative contact due visibility.
questions.trans: 由于能见度，不能看见（那一架飞机）。

questions.content: Unable, we are in IMC.
questions.trans: 不能，我们在仪表天气条件。

questions.content: Unable, we are only authorized during daytime VMC.
questions.trans: 不能，我们只有白天目视气象条件的资格。

questions.content: Unable noise abatement due company policy.
questions.trans: 由于公司政策，不能执行降噪音程序。

questions.content: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
questions.trans: 雷达移交时前面的管制员告诉你我们的问题了吗？

questions.content: Is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point?
questions.trans: 在此强制性报告点需要换频率吗？

questions.content: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
questions.trans: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要保持光洁形态和适当的速度。

questions.content: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you’d like.
questions.trans: 速度不能调至低于马赫数点74。你可以引导让我们飞航向。

questions.content: Request runway change for departure due high crosswind.
questions.trans: 由于较大侧风，请求换起飞跑道。

questions.content: Request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits.
questions.trans: 由于顺风超限，请求延迟进近。

questions.content: Request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold.
questions.trans: 由于跑道入口处附近的天气，请求等待指令。

questions.content: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
questions.trans: 不能，立即右转的话我们越过地形的裕度可能不够。当前速度的转弯半径是4海里。

questions.content: Sorry, there was a problem with my audio equipment. How do you read me now?
questions.trans: 抱歉，因为我们的音频设备有问题。现在你听我几个？

questions.content: We had to overshoot because of wake turbulence.
questions.trans: 我们不得不复飞的原因是尾流。

questions.content: Not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft.
questions.trans: 没有准备好立即起飞，刚起飞的重型机可能有尾流。

questions.content: Unable CAT II approach due crew qualification.
questions.trans: 不能Ⅱ类进近的原因是机组资质。 Note: CAT读为Catgory。

questions.content: Transmission blocked, say again.
questions.trans: 被干扰了，再说一遍。

questions.content: Standby, high pilot workload.
questions.trans: 稍等，飞行员工作负荷较大。

questions.content: Are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type?
questions.trans: 你禁止我们飞入是因为我们公司或我们的机型吗？

questions.content: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
questions.trans: 我们飞机有相应的资质，你们民航当局也批准我们可以执行定期航班。

questions.content: We had to go around due to unstable approach.
questions.trans: 我们必须复飞是因为进近不稳定。

questions.content: The air conditioning system has malfunctioned.
questions.trans: 空调系统已故障。

questions.content: We have only one air conditioning pack operational. Request a new cruising level below FL300.
questions.trans: 我们仅有一个空调组件运行。请求新的巡航高度低于高度300。

questions.content: All our air conditioning packs have malfunctioned. Request rapid descent to MEA .
questions.trans: 我们全部的空调组件已故障。请求快速下降到最低航路高度。

questions.content: We had a malfunction of one air conditioning pack. Request descent to a lower level.
questions.trans: 我们有一个空调组件故障。请求下降到较低高度。

questions.content: We have lost electrical power to the cabin air compressor. Request immediate descent to 10,000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们的客舱空气压缩机失去电源。请求立即下降到10000英尺。

questions.content: We just had a smoke emergency. We need to depressurize the airplane to let in fresh air. Request rapid descent to 8000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们刚发生烟雾紧急状况。需要释压让新鲜空气进入飞机。请求快速下降到8000英尺。

questions.content: We have unusual smell from air conditioning packs. Request stop climb at 7000 feet.
questions.trans: 空调组件出现异常气味。请求在7000英尺，停止爬升。

questions.content: Many passengers are suffering from smoke inhalation. Request medical assistance on arrival.
questions.trans: 许多旅客遭受烟尘吸入。请求到达时医疗救助。

questions.content: Our pressurization system has malfunctioned.
questions.trans: 我们的增压系统故障。

questions.content: We have difficulty in controlling the cabin pressure.
questions.trans: 我们控制座舱增压有难度。

questions.content: We have a cabin altitude problem.
questions.trans: 我们座舱高度有问题。

questions.content: Our cabin rate of climb has red-lined. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们座舱上升率已达到红线。请求立即下降。

questions.content: We have a slow cabin decompression. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们座舱慢释压，请求立即下降。

questions.content: Our cabin altitude at one time had reached 16000 feet. Some passengers have symptoms of hypoxia.
questions.trans: 我们的座舱高度曾达到了16000英尺。部分旅客有缺氧症状。

questions.content: We are now depressurized and will fly a more shallow descent profile.
questions.trans: 我们现在释压飞行，需要更平缓的下降剖面。

questions.content: Request descent rate less than 500 feet per minute due to unpressurized cabin.
questions.trans: 由于客舱失压，请求下降率小于每分钟500英尺。

questions.content: We are now ventilating with ram air. It is best that our rate of descent does not exceed 600 feet per minute.
questions.trans: 我们现在通过冲压空气通风，我们下降率最好不超过每分钟600英尺.

questions.content: We have a problem with the avionics ventilation system.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风系统有问题。

questions.content: We have an avionics ventilation problem. The skin heat-exchangers and blower fan have failed.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风有问题。蒙皮热交换器和吹风扇都故障了。

questions.content: The avionics ventilation is unserviceable. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 电子舱通风故障。请求备降到就近合适机场。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We have severe vibration coming from the avionics ventilation fan.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风风扇严重抖振。

questions.content: There are unusual noises coming from the avionics bay.
questions.trans: 电子设备舱有异常噪音。

questions.content: Our FMS has malfunctioned. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们的飞行管理系统故障了，请求雷达引导。

questions.content: Request further climb due wind-shear.
questions.trans: 由于风切变，申请进一步爬升。

questions.content: Unable to maintain altitude, request leaving RVSM airspace.
questions.trans: 不能保持高度，申请离开RVSM空域。

questions.content: We cannot make RNP approach due equipment.
questions.trans: 由于设备，我们不再符合RNP进近。

questions.content: Our navigation accuracy is low. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
questions.trans: 我们的导航精度低。请求上升到最低安全高度。

questions.content: We have a navigation map shift, unable to perform the RNAV approach. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们有导航地图漂移，无法飞RNAV进近。申请雷达引导。

questions.content: Inertial reference system has failed. We are navigating on raw data. Request conventional approach.
questions.trans: 惯导失效了，我们正在使用原始导航，申请传统进近。

questions.content: The Morse code for the VOR is different from the approach chart. Confirm the VOR is fully operational.
questions.trans: VOR的莫尔斯代码与我们进近图上的不一致。证实VOR台在运行中。

questions.content: The ILS signal seems to be very unstable. Did any other pilot report a similar situation?
questions.trans: 盲降信号不稳定，其他飞行员报告过类似情况吗？

questions.content: The approach lights for Runway 36L are a bit different from those shown on the airport diagram.
questions.trans: 36左跑道的进近灯光与机场图上的显示有点不同。

questions.content: The flight path is unstable. Going around.
questions.trans: 飞行轨迹不稳定。复飞了。

questions.content: We made a missed approach due to unstable ILS signals.
questions.trans: 由于盲降信号不稳定，我们执行了复飞。

questions.content: The ILS signal was unstable. Request approach to another runway or request another type of approach.
questions.trans: 盲降信号不稳定。申请换一条跑道进近，或申请另一种进近方式。

questions.content: The DME indication is not correct. Confirm the DME is still in service.
questions.trans: DME显示不对。证实DME还在运行中。

questions.content: We have lost our flight plan after a flight management computer reset.
questions.trans: 我们复位了飞行管理计算机后丢失了飞行计划。

questions.content: We need a few minutes to reprogram the flight management computers. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们需要几分钟重新输程序到飞行管理计算机，申请雷达引导。

questions.content: We need to reconfigure the flight management computers for approach. Request holding instructions.
questions.trans: 我们需要重新设置飞行管理计算机，申请等待指令。

questions.content: We are now flying with basic navigation due to systems failure. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 由于系统故障，我们现在使用基本导航飞行。申请雷达引导。

questions.content: We have multiple failures on the inertial reference system. We are no longer able to fly oceanic route. Request return for landing.
questions.trans: 我们有多个惯导失效，我们不能再跨洋飞行，申请返场着陆。

questions.content: We do not meet GPS approach requirement due to flight crew qualifications.
questions.trans: 由于机组资格，我们不符合GPS进近要求。

questions.content: Our Airline policy does not allow us to perform CAT IIIC approach.
questions.trans: 我们公司政策不允许我们执行IIIC类进近。

questions.content: Our operations manual forbids this procedure.
questions.trans: 我们的运行手册禁止该程序。

questions.content: Our Aviation Authority does not permit this procedure.
questions.trans: 我们航空当局不允许该程序。

questions.content: We are unable to conform to the noise abatement procedure due performance.
questions.trans: 由于性能，我们不遵守降噪程序。

questions.content: We are not qualified for CAT IIIB approach and auto-land. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们不具备IIIB类进近和自动着陆资格。请求改航。

questions.content: Our VHF number One receiver has failed. We are no longer monitoring 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们第一部甚高频接收机失效，我们不再监听121.5。

questions.content: All stations, transmitting blind due to receiver failure.
questions.trans: 各台注意，由于接收机失效，正在盲发。

questions.content: All of our VHF transmitters have failed, now transmitting on HF radio. Please respond.
questions.trans: 我们所有甚高频发射机都失效了，现在高频无线电发报，请回复。

questions.content: Our SELCAL has malfunctioned. We will continue monitoring your frequency.
questions.trans: 我们的选择呼叫失效了，我们会继续监听频率。

questions.content: We are receiving an ELT signal on 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们在121.5里听到一个紧急定位发射机信号。

questions.content: We are picking up a broadcast signal on 121.5.
questions.trans: 有人在121.5里发射信号。

questions.content: Our satellite phone is unserviceable. We are unable to call company operations.
questions.trans: 我们的卫星电话今天不工作，我们联系不上公司签派。

questions.content: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request re-release the flight plan by voice.
questions.trans: 我们数据链故障了，申请口头式的二次放行飞行计划。

questions.content: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request ATC clearance by voice.
questions.trans: 我们的数据链故障了，申请口头式的ATC放行许可。

questions.content: My apologies, I wasn’t aware the boom mike was transmitting.
questions.trans: 不好意思，我没发觉手持话筒在发射。

questions.content: Sorry for blocking the frequency due microphone jammed.
questions.trans: 抱歉由于麦克风卡阻堵塞了通信频率。

questions.content: We have an electrical failure.
questions.trans: 我们有一个电气故障。

questions.content: One of our generators has failed. At present moment, we are still able to continue to our destination.
questions.trans: 我们一部发电机故障了。目前看来，还能够继续飞往目的地。

questions.content: Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport due AC BUS failure.
questions.trans: 我们一个交流汇流条故障了，申请备降到最近合适机场。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We are not supplying power to our DC BUS. Request priority landing.
questions.trans: 我们不再为直流汇流条供电，申请优先落地。

questions.content: We have a problem with the aircraft battery. Request priority landing.
questions.trans: 我们飞机电瓶有问题。申请优先落地。

questions.content: One of our transformers has failed. I’ll let you know if a diversion is required.
questions.trans: 我们一个变压整流器故障了。如果需要备降我会第一时间告诉你。

questions.content: Electrical system has a serious malfunction. Request radar vectors to an airport that’s within 20 minutes of flight time.
questions.trans: 电力设备有严重故障。申请雷达引导到20分钟以内能够飞到的机场。

questions.content: We are operating with only the emergency generator. Request track direct to final, Runway 26.
questions.trans: 我们能够使用的只有紧急发电机。申请直飞五边，跑道26号。

questions.content: We are flying with batteries only. Is there any airport available within 25 minutes of flying?
questions.trans: 我们仅依靠电瓶飞行。有没有25分钟之内能够飞到的可用机场？

questions.content: If there is no airport within 100 miles, we have to make a forced landing.
questions.trans: 如果100海里范围内没有机场，我们必须迫降。

questions.content: We have less than 10 minutes of battery power left. We are preparing for ditching procedure.
questions.trans: 我们的电瓶电源供电不足10分钟，我们正在准备水上迫降程序。

questions.content: We have switched off most of our electrical systems for smoke procedure. Request vectors for a long final, Runway 15.
questions.trans: 为了排烟程序，我们关掉了大部分电气系统。申请引导到长五边，跑道15号。

questions.content: We have cut off the electrical system to the cabin and the onboard fire is under control.
questions.trans: 我们已经切断了到客舱的电气系统，机上火情得到了控制。

questions.content: We had an electrical fire from the galley, now extinguished. Request return to land.
questions.trans: 我们有厨房电气火警，现在已经熄灭。请求返场着陆。

questions.content: There was a fire from the avionics bay. Request radar vectors for final.
questions.trans: 电子设备舱有火警。请求雷达引导到五边。

questions.content: We have had a bird strike. Our windshield has cracked.
questions.trans: 我们遭遇鸟击，风挡出现裂痕。

questions.content: The windshield suddenly had electrical arcing. We need to pull the circuit breakers and delay the approach.
questions.trans: 风挡突然出现电弧，我们需要拨跳开关并推迟进近。

questions.content: The cockpit side window is not sealed properly. Request reduce to minimum speed and descend to 4000 feet.
questions.trans: 驾驶舱侧窗没关好，申请减速到最小速度，下降到4000英尺。

questions.content: We had to go around due pilot seat moving. We’ll try to reset the circuit breaker before making another approach.
questions.trans: 刚才复飞是由于驾驶员座椅自己移动了，我们得先试着复位椅子的跳开关再进近。

questions.content: We have already discharged the engine extinguishers. The fire warning light is still on. Do you have a visual on our left engine?
questions.trans: 我们已经释放了发动机灭火瓶，火警灯仍然亮。你们能目视看看我们的左发是否有火？

questions.content: We cannot extinguish the engine fire. Request priority landing and emergency services on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们不能熄灭发动机火情。申请优先落地和到场时的紧急服务。

questions.content: We have an APU fire warning. Can you verify if there is smoke coming from the back of the plane?
questions.trans: 我们有APU火警。你能否看到我们飞机后部是否有烟雾？

questions.content: The APU fire seems to be extinguished. Request fire trucks on standby and stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
questions.trans: APU火情看样子被熄灭了，申请消防车待命，还有客梯车以便让旅客下飞机。

questions.content: The APU is still on fire. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: APU火还在燃烧，我们现在紧急撤离，申请紧急服务。

questions.content: We had a cargo smoke warning. Advise the ground handlers NOT to open our cargo door until the passengers have all disembarked.
questions.trans: 我们有个货舱烟雾警告。请告知地面装卸人员在所有旅客下飞机之前千万别打开货舱门。

questions.content: A passenger ignited the lavatory waste bin. Advise the airport police to await our arrival.
questions.trans: 一名旅客点燃了盥洗室垃圾桶。告知机场警察到场来处理。

questions.content: We have smoke coming out of our avionics bay. It is out of control. Request proceed direct to final and cancel all speed restrictions.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。已经失控了。申请直飞五边并取消全部速度限制。

questions.content: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are evacuating. Request fire trucks.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。我们正在紧急撤离。申请消防车。

questions.content: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are disembarking the passengers.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱，我们正在让旅客离机。

questions.content: Request descent to 10000 feet to ventilate the aircraft due smoke.
questions.trans: 由于烟雾，请求下降到10000 英尺使飞机得到通风。

questions.content: We have emptied most of our fire extinguishers, but the cabin fire is still on.
questions.trans: 我们已经释放了灭火瓶，但客舱火警仍然存在。

questions.content: We are having flight control problems.
questions.trans: 我们有飞行操纵问题。

questions.content: Our flight control computers are not functioning well. We are having difficulty maintaining level flight, unable RVSM.
questions.trans: 我们飞行操作计算机工作不太理想，我们保持平飞有些困难，不能在RVSM空域飞行。

questions.content: Our pitch control has malfunctioned. We cannot move the elevators. We are flying the airplane with only trim.
questions.trans: 我们俯仰控制失效了，升降舵动不了，我们尝试用配平来控制飞机。

questions.content: The aircraft has a tendency to roll to the right. I need additional airspace to maneuver.
questions.trans: 飞机有向右横滚的趋势，我需要更多的的空域来机动。

questions.content: We have finished the checklist but still cannot retract some of the speed brakes. Request the longest runway for landing.
questions.trans: 我们完成了检查单但还是不能收回一部分减速板。申请最长的跑道落地。

questions.content: We cannot fully extend the flaps. Request the longest runway for landing.
questions.trans: 我们不能完全放出襟翼，申请最长的跑道落地。

questions.content: We have asymmetric flaps. Airplane is rolling to the left. Request holding to solve the problem.
questions.trans: 我们的襟翼位置不对称，飞机向左横滚，请求等待以解决问题。

questions.content: Request high speed approach. Part of our flight control surfaces have separated from the wing.
questions.trans: 请求大速度进近。部分飞机操作面与机翼分离。

questions.content: Request immediate climb above the minimum safe altitude to perform the checklist due to run-away trim condition.
questions.trans: 由于配平失控，申请立即上安全高度以上来做检查单。

questions.content: Request vectors for long final. We are controlling the airplane with mechanical backup.
questions.trans: 请求雷达引导到长五边。我们正用机械备用设备操作飞机。

questions.content: Request return to FL250.We just had an air-upset situation and lost a lot of altitude.
questions.trans: 申请回到高度250，我们刚才有空中异常姿态的情况，而且掉了很多高度。

questions.content: We have a problem with yaw damping. The aircraft is oscillating severely. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们偏航阻尼出现问题，飞机摇摆很严重，申请备降。

questions.content: We have lost electrical power to some of the flight control actuators. Request delay our descent to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 我们的一些飞机操纵作动筒失去了电源。申请延迟下降来做检查单。

questions.content: Some of our fuel pumps have low pressure. Request descent.
questions.trans: 一些燃油泵低压。请求下降。

questions.content: We have a problem with fuel temperature. Request holding position on the taxiway.
questions.trans: 我们的燃油温度有问题。请求滑行道上原地等待。

questions.content: We are leaking fuel slowly. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们有慢速漏油。申请改航。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We have a severe fuel leak situation, unable to reach the closest airport. You can expect us to make a forced landing near our present location.
questions.trans: 我们有严重漏油情况，无法抵达最近的机场，估计会在我们当前位置附近地点做紧急迫降。

questions.content: Our cabin crew reports that we have fuel leak from the right wing. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们客舱乘务员报告说右机翼漏油，申请飞往最近合适机场备降。

questions.content: We have already shut down engine Number One, but it is still leaking fuel near the pylon. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 我们已经关了一发，但发动机吊架附近仍然在漏油。申请紧急服务。

questions.content: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a bit of fuel from the bottom of the right engine nacelle. We are delaying taxi.
questions.trans: 地面人员（机务）报告我们右发吊舱下方有漏燃油，我们延迟滑行。

questions.content: We need to continue to run the engines at our present location for a few minutes, will advise you shortly.
questions.trans: 我们需要在当前位置让发动机运转几分钟，将很快告知你们。

questions.content: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of Number Three engine. We have just shut it down.
questions.trans: 地面人员（机务）报告我们三发下方有大量燃油泄漏，我们刚刚关车了。
